title: Kalmar Castle
visualBrief: Open irregular Renaissance courtyard and four gabled wings,three round and one dodecagonal tower with distinct copper helmets,square Kuretornet with open lantern/old entrance,white Renaissance gables,original well canopy,mapped outer defenses and four cannon towers with western timber bridge.

nativeAxes.front: Mapped western bridge and old Kuretornet entrance, baked into East/South coordinates
nativeAxes.origin: Exact-QID footprint map anchor; model ground attachment Y4.2 is an original provisional castle-platform estimate. Outer defenses descend toY0.3.

identityFeatures: Four differentiated green copper helmets and tall square western lantern tower
Irregular courtyard void surrounded by four dark gabled palace wings
White Renaissance gables and grass outer defenses with four cannon towers

reconstruction.scope: Present-day exterior: hollow courtyard ring with four gabled wings,four differentiated copper tower caps,square Kuretornet and physical old-gate passage,selected white Renaissance gables,original well canopy,outer grass defenses and four separately mapped cannon towers,timber approach bridge and access route.
reconstruction.basis: Own mapped coordinates plus original interpretation of operator/SFV primary history and aerial/moat photographs. No traced printed drawing,downloaded mesh or photo texture.
reconstruction.referenceState: Current-state approximation; vertical heights,roof profiles,apertures,outer banks and modern fixtures remain estimates.

geographicProposal.reviewStatus: Inactive draft; all vertical values are estimated. Real terrain/coast/moat/approach and current-state kitchen extension need review.

scaleBasis: Exact-QID physical outline and courtyard plus mapped castle parts,coast,defense walls and western approach. Horizontal dimensions derive from attributed coordinates; all heights,roof profiles,apertures and ground section are original estimates.
geometrySource: Original deterministic exterior geometry; no downloaded meshes or copied photographic textures. Footprint-derived registration includes separately attributed OpenStreetMap evidence.
sourceLicense: Original geometry under repository license; own mapped traces © OpenStreetMap contributors,ODbL-1.0. Primary photographs are not redistributed.
dataAttribution: © OpenStreetMap contributors; Statens fastighetsverk; Kalmar Slott.
materialMethod: Canonical shared material graphs bound through molenSurface extras with metric coordinates divided by central repeat meters. Vertex colors provide component tint. Glass retains opaque metallic-roughness PBR; no bitmap texture copies per model.
reviewStatus: source-geometry; near/far and shared-material captures pending
limitations: Exact-QID relation preserves castle footprint/courtyard. Nearby defense traces,coast,towers and bridge remain separately associated; the current map is not a survey.
No published numeric height verified. All vertical values,helmets/lanterns,roof partitioning,apertures,white gables,well and bank section are original photographic estimates.
